# Peer futex parser fixture

`x86_64.serial` is the peer-only excerpt of the actual x86_64 QEMU serial log
`/tmp/obfuscation-futex-peer-guest-v1/serial.log`, SHA-256
`69aa4335f6ec8c7a79cb2a07a8729a7cd510515850d1dfbccc479d7a3fac4960`.
It is retained input for parser regression controls, not a new execution claim.
The original guest receipt pins its ELF, SDK, disk, commands and full serial log.
